tagline: The first link out of Bali — Gilis, Mandalika, and the bridge to Komodo.
summary: Lombok is the pivot of the hero island-hopping chain: the Gili islands and Mandalika draw high day-trip volumes close in, while Lombok is the natural stepping-stone from Bali toward Komodo and Sumba. Pioneer II handles the Gili and Bali-Lombok hops; Quanta-LR carries the longer reach toward Komodo.

transit_planning: For an operator: a premium water tier relieving the crowded Gili fast-boat corridor and forming the central pivot of the Bali → Lombok → Komodo → Sumba luxury chain.

grab.note: Lombok extends the Grab Bali phase — Gili hops plus the bridge toward Komodo.
